name: 94606 · Oakland, CA
findings: ZIP 94606 (Oakland) has 134 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94606 (Oakland) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94606 (Oakland) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.
